candidate-repair-revision.title: Revise repair plan
candidate-repair-revision.intro: Select a new workflow and native tool for this same repair task. A revision prepares a separate preview; review it before starting.
candidate-repair-revision.historical: Earlier repair plan. Its recorded run and results remain available.
candidate-repair-revision.creator: Prepared by
candidate-repair-revision.observed_help: This earlier definition was recorded when revision history began. This time is the observation time, not its original preparation time.
candidate-repair-revision.recovery: The revision response is uncertain. Recover the original request to locate its exact preview before making another change.
candidate-repair-revision.eligible_ready: This unstarted plan can be revised. Its original conflict and ordered sources stay fixed.
candidate-repair-revision.eligible_certi: The host certified failure before workspace and process entry. A replacement preview can be prepared while retaining the failed run.
candidate-repair-revision.blocked: A revision is unavailable under the current facts. Keep the original operation and run for recovery.
candidate-repair-revision.choose_workflo: Choose a workflow with independent tests
candidate-repair-revision.tool_help: Choose a currently available native tool with administrator-enabled conflict repair.
candidate-repair-revision.codex_blocked: Codex does not support the required repair workspace
candidate-repair-revision.route_help: The server fixes the current project route in the new preview and rechecks it at Start.
candidate-repair-revision.ack: I reviewed the selected workflow, native tool and current route, and want a new preview for this same task.
candidate-repair-revision.refresh_failed: Current revision facts could not be read. Your selections and reason are retained; refresh before confirming again.
candidate-repair-revision.reason.repair_: Conflict repair plan was superseded; open its current reviewed revision
Conflict repair revision requires a current ready plan or certified startup failure
Conflict repair recovery changed or requires reconciliation of the original run
Conflict repair revision family reached its limit of 32 plans
candidate-repair-revision.reason.startup: Host startup failure proof does not match the fixed failed repair attempt
candidate-repair-revision.reason.history: Task execution history request is invalid
